Application Data.NAME: Cinema Emporium
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Cinema Emporium is a retail store specializing in a diverse selection of video and media products, including films, documentaries, and gaming content. Operating for over 5 years, we pride ourselves on offering a wide range of titles for various genres and age groups, catering to both casual viewers and media enthusiasts. Our store features a modern layout with comfortable viewing areas and knowledgeable staff to assist customers in finding the right content. We also host community events such as movie nights and discussions, aimed at promoting appreciation for film and media. To safeguard our assets and ensure customer safety, we have invested in a state-of-the-art security system, including surveillance cameras, an advanced alarm system, and controlled access to our premises. Our team undergoes regular training in safety protocols and customer service to maintain a welcoming and secure shopping environment.

Underwriting Guidelines:
3.115
Video & Media Stores
Underwriting Appetite
• Preferred:
– Established businesses with at least 3 years of continuous operation and a demonstrated
low loss history.
– Premises equipped with a professionally monitored alarm system, including burglar and
fire alarms.
– Locations with controlled access, adequate lighting, and security cameras to deter theft
and vandalism.
– Businesses that maintain comprehensive employee training programs focused on safety
and loss prevention.
• Acceptable:
– Specialty or niche video/media stores, including those operating primarily online or
hosting occasional special events, provided appropriate endorsements are added.
– Stores with moderate loss history but with clear mitigation measures implemented.
– Businesses that have recently upgraded security systems or improved operational controls
but have less than 3 years tenure.
• Not Acceptable:
– Businesses without any alarm or security systems in place.
